intent.goal: Improve debugging and observability with meaningful, side-effect-free debug logging in non-test pkg Go files, following project logger conventions.
intent.acceptance: An immutable actual-parent transition prevents evaluation of a pre-existing nontrivial logging argument while debug logging is disabled, by placing the otherwise preserved logger call behind that same logger's Enabled condition. Count guarded computation sites, not added logs. AST verification must bind imported logger identity, call, enclosing function and unchanged computation. Logger runtime source must independently establish disabled logging discards calls. Broader behavior and usefulness remain unknown.
